primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: WEB固定版の使徒17:15で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.
WEB固定版の使徒17:16で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
WEB固定版の使徒17:22で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.
WEB固定版の使徒18:1で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.
